ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping tool built with Flutter designed specifically to instantly generate, scaffold, and test UI variations based on sudden mystery prompt changes during a compressed 6-hour hackathon sprint.
ideas.problem_statement: AppSurd '26 Mystery Prompt Challenge requiring teams to rapidly ideate, build, and pitch based on an unconventional mystery prompt in 5 to 6 hours.
ideas.title: FlutterMysteryPromptSimulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core chaotic constraint of the hackathon—rapid adaptability to a mystery prompt—making it deeply relatable to judges experiencing the same time crunch.

ideas.pitch: An AI-enhanced cross-platform lost and found mobile app built with Flutter that uses image matching to automatically connect misplaced items with their rightful owners on campus.
ideas.problem_statement: AppSurd '26 Mystery Prompt Challenge featuring beginner-friendly cross-platform app development requirements.
ideas.title: CampusLostAndFoundFlutter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an everyday pain felt directly by students and organisers on campus, leveraging proven multimodal matching patterns while strictly adhering to the mandatory Flutter tech stack.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight mobile application built with Flutter to track, gamify, and optimize sustainable resource usage and recycling habits within college dorms and departments.
ideas.problem_statement: AppSurd '26 Mystery Prompt Challenge focusing on rapid mobile prototyping for practical college utility.
ideas.title: GreenCampusFlutterTracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to university-level judges looking for practical sustainability initiatives that can be deployed immediately within IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

ideas.pitch: A snappy, offline-first mobile nutrition assistant built with Flutter that delivers instant meal recommendations and calorie tracking using local caching for zero-latency performance.
ideas.problem_statement: AppSurd '26 Mystery Prompt Challenge requiring functional cross-platform app development within a strict 5 to 6-hour sprint.
ideas.title: FlutterNutritionBite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on exceptionally polished UI/UX design and zero-lag performance, which is critical when judges only have minutes to evaluate a rapid prototype.

ideas.pitch: A minimalist mobile matching utility built in Flutter that connects students across different departments and years for spontaneous, ad-hoc peer study sessions.
ideas.problem_statement: AppSurd '26 Mystery Prompt Challenge welcoming inter-specialization and inter-college team collaboration themes.
ideas.title: PeerStudyFlutterHub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the inter-departmental collaboration rules of the hackathon, winning over judges with hyper-local relevance.
